text.en:
Section one of Executive Order No. 331,
dated July 7, 1950, is hereby amended by setting up a
new ceiling price for Pan de Sal, as follows:
FOODSTUFF (LOCAL)
ceiling price
3 pieces (23 grams each) or 2
pieces (35 grams each) .......

The ceiling price fixed in this Order includes
the seven per cent sales tax and is applicable throughout
the Phiiippines.

This Order shall take effect five days after the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
5891
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
